title: Sīlam
text: 2. Suriyassa bhikkhave udayato etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittaṃ yad idam aruṇuggaṃ || evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ariyassa aṭṭhaṅgikassa maggassa uppādāya etam pubbaṅgamam etam pubbanimittam yad idam sīlasampadā || 3. Sīlasampannassetam bhikkhave bhikkhuno patikaṅkham || la ||
